name: SX-3228
summary: SX-3228 is a sedative and hypnotic drug used in scientific research. It has similar effects to sedative-hypnotic benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine hypnotic.

pharmacology.text: SX-3228 is a subtype-selective GABAA positive allosteric modulator acting primarily at the α1 subtype.

uses.text: SX-3228 is a sedative and hypnotic drug used in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Sedatives acting at this site, such as zolpidem and the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory gaps and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於這個位置的鎮靜劑，例如佐沛眠與苯二氮平類，可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶空白與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于这个位置的镇静剂，例如佐沛眠与苯二氮平类，可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆空白与依赖。

fact.en: Like zolpidem, it acts mainly on the α1 type of GABA-A receptor, the subtype most linked to sedation and sleep.
fact.zh: 與佐沛眠一樣，它主要作用於α1型GABA-A受體，這個亞型與鎮靜和睡眠的關係最密切。
fact.zhHans: 与佐沛眠一样，它主要作用于α1型GABA-A受体，这个亚型与镇静和睡眠的关系最密切。
